GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XU_YING.title: Phantom
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XU_YING.description: Cannot be played manually. After you play a non-Phantom Attack, this card may trigger automatically.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_UNIQUE.title: Unique
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_UNIQUE.description: Each player may keep only one copy of a card with this name in their permanent deck.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XIAN_GU.title: Immortal Gu
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XIAN_GU.description: A Rank 6 or higher Gu. During this run, only one copy of the same Immortal Gu may exist across all players' permanent decks.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_RANK1.title: Rank 1
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_RANK2.title: Rank 2
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_RANK3.title: Rank 3
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_RANK4.title: Rank 4
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_RANK5.title: Rank 5
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_RANK6.title: Rank 6
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_RANK7.title: Rank 7
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_RANK8.title: Rank 8
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_RANK9.title: Rank 9
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_CUI_DONG.title: Activation
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_CUI_DONG.description: A Gu card requires an available Activation card in hand. Confirming the Gu automatically pays for and plays one Activation.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_HUI_FU.title: Recovery
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_HUI_FU.description: After all activations are spent, the Gu enters recovery and returns to the Gu pile after the listed number of turns.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_HE_LIAN.title: Fusion
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_HE_LIAN.description: Consumes the specified Gu materials to refine a new Gu. Its rank follows the recipe and it is normally excluded from rewards.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XUE_YUAN.title: Blood Essence
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XUE_YUAN.description: A Blood Path combat resource capped at 12 and cleared after combat.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XUE_JI.title: Blood Parasite
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XUE_JI.description: A parasite attached to a normal Attack, Skill, or Power. It follows its host through hand, draw, and discard piles.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XUE_QI.title: Blood Qi
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XUE_QI.description: Adapts to the host: damage and Bleed, Block and Blood Essence, or direct Blood Essence. Higher ranks trigger multiple times.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YUE_XIANG.title: Moon Phase
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YUE_XIANG.descriptio: Blood Moon advances Crescent → Waxing → Full. Each complete host resolution advances one phase.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XUE_TAI.title: Blood Fetus
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XUE_TAI.description: A compound parasite. Each trigger adapts to the host and gains Fetal Movement; it hatches at 3.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_TAI_DONG.title: Fetal Movement
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_TAI_DONG.description: Blood Fetus maturity. It hatches at 3; devouring another parasite can inherit 1–2 progress.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_PO_TAI.title: Rupture
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_PO_TAI.description: If an immature parasitized host enters Exhaust, remove the parasite and gain 1 Blood Essence without resolving remaining effects.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_FU_HUA.title: Hatch
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_FU_HUA.description: The final resolution after a parasite completes its last trigger, after which it is removed.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_TUN_JI.title: Devour Parasite
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_TUN_JI.description: Blood Fetus replaces Blood Qi or a non-Full Moon parasite and inherits 1–2 Fetal Movement.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_ZONG_E_DU.title: Shared Pool
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_ZONG_E_DU.descriptio: AoE damage, Bleed, or Blood Marks are shared totals divided among living enemies, not copied per enemy.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YI_HAI.title: Remains
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YI_HAI.description: A 0-cost Status created by parasitic kills. It can grant Blood Essence or be consumed by Blood Skull and Blood Bat effects.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XUE_LU.title: Blood Skull
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XUE_LU.description: Up to 3. Strengthens parasites, defenses, and Blood Bats; absorbing Remains at cap heals instead.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_LIU_XUE.title: Bleed
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_LIU_XUE.description: At the end of the target turn, remove 1, deal 3 damage, and grant the applier 1 Blood Essence.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XUE_YIN.title: Blood Mark
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XUE_YIN.description: After Blood Path attack damage from the applier, consume 1 and lose 3 HP. A card play refunds at most 1 Blood Essence globally.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_CAN_YUE.title: Crescent
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_CAN_YUE.description: Moon Phase stage 1. Resolve the lower shared damage and Bleed pool, then advance to Waxing.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YING_YUE.title: Waxing
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YING_YUE.description: Moon Phase stage 2. Resolve the middle shared pool and possible Blood Marks, then advance to Full.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_MAN_YUE.title: Full Moon
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_MAN_YUE.description: Final Moon Phase. Resolve the largest shared pool and hatch; rank 6+ refunds Blood Essence and rank 9 also draws.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_GU_CHONG.title: Gu Worm
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_GU_CHONG.description: Stored in the dedicated Gu pile and used through an Activation card in hand. It does not enter the normal draw cycle.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YUAN_QI.title: Primeval Essence
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YUAN_QI.description: The combat resource used to activate Gu worms. The icon in the Gu card's cost position shows this resource rather than normal Energy.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XIAN_YUAN.title: Immortal Essence
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XIAN_YUAN.descriptio: An additional activation resource for Rank 6 or higher Immortal Gu. A depleted essence card is Exhausted after the entire Gu play sequence finishes.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_GUANG_HUI.title: Radiance
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_GUANG_HUI.descriptio: A Light-path combat resource with a maximum of 9. It persists during combat and can pay for Illumination effects.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_ZHE_GUANG.title: Refraction
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_ZHE_GUANG.descriptio: Alternating between different Light-path Attack, Skill, or Power types grants Radiance, up to a per-turn limit.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_ZHAO_PO.title: Exposure
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_ZHAO_PO.description: The next hit from an Attack card deals bonus damage per stack and removes 1 stack. Multi-hit attacks read it one hit at a time.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_JU_GUANG.title: Focus Light
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_JU_GUANG.description: Increases the first damage hit of the next Light-path Attack. Fixed bonus damage is not repeated by multi-hit attacks.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_DING_GUANG.title: Fixed Light
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_DING_GUANG.descripti: Increases the first hit of the next Attack that strikes a target already carrying Exposure, then clears after the first Attack damage resolves.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA.title: Illumination
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA.description: Automatically spends the listed Radiance to empower this Gu or its generated card.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_LIU_GUANG.title: Stored Light
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_LIU_GUANG.descriptio: At end of turn, gain Radiance if enough Block remains. Each application resolves once.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_PO_JING.title: Shattered Mirror
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_PO_JING.description: Gain Radiance the first time Block is completely broken during the current defense window. Each application triggers once.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YI_CHU.title: Overflow
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YI_CHU.description: When a resource gain exceeds its cap, the amount that could not be gained is converted into another benefit as stated by the card.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_ZHUI_JI.title: Pursuit
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_ZHUI_JI.description: If the target dies, unresolved remaining hits move to another living enemy.
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XUE_HE.title: Blood River
GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XUE_HE.description: Automatically chooses a supply mode or high-defense mode based on current Blood Essence. High-defense mode spends Blood Essence and carries part of its Block into next turn.
